survey: A three-branch brass candelabra, seen from the front and a little above. A round domed base with a stepped rim carries a turned central stem with two bulb-shaped knots. At the upper knot, two U-shaped arms leave the stem as one piece and curve up to drip cups on the left and right. The stem continues above that knot to a taller center cup. Each of the three cups holds an upright white candle with a wick and one flame. The arms are close to mirror images, and the left and right cups sit at about the same height. The center candle is raised, as on real candelabras. The base is wide enough to carry the weight of the arms. The object is shown against a backdrop with no floor, which is normal for card art.
